title: Storm and Panic in the Hill Campaign

blocks.text: The Kahilur side finally prepares for open war, but Baghard Singh’s blows and arrows begin breaking their pride, even bringing down key animals and arrangements made for battle.
At the same time a warning reaches the Mandi wazir about a coming fire from above, and the combination of storm, flame, and Banda’s reputation deepens the panic around the hill chiefs.
The page binds military blows and omen-like fear together, showing the Mandi wazir drawn into a widening sense of crisis.
